project_name: NexusERP PME - O ERP Mais Moderno do Brasil

typography.headings_rule: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for main headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans with tracking-tight. Uppercase subheaders with tracking-[0.2em] font-mono.

layout_and_spacing.card_padding_rule: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent edge text collision.
layout_and_spacing.kanban_layout: Horizontal scrollable grid with 6 sticky column headers, col width min-w-[280px] max-w-[320px], custom scrollbar, drop target highlight glow.
layout_and_spacing.drawer_layout: Slide-out Sheet from right (w-full sm:w-[540px] md:w-[640px]), backdrop blur, chat history + lead details tabs.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B High Density Grid: Summary Cards col-span-1, Revenue Chart col-span-2/full, Tax Breakdown & Receivables col-span-1.

kanban_board.drag_and_drop: Smooth Framer Motion or HTML5 DnD with active card elevation shadow-2xl scale-[1.02] border-emerald-500/50

whatsapp_drawer.chat_bubbles: WhatsApp style incoming dark slate background, outgoing emerald gradient background, timestamp in font-mono, read status double check icon.
whatsapp_drawer.evolution_api_badge: Real-time webhook badge indicator 'Evolution API Active' with animated green pulse point.

fiscal_nfe.tax_breakdown_widget: Interactive tax decomposition progress bars showing ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IPI values with tooltips and NFe JSON viewer dialog.

financial_dashboard.kpi_cards: Flat cards with 1px border, subtle gradient highlight on hover, sparkline indicator, metric big font-mono text-2xl.
financial_dashboard.charts: Recharts ResponsiveContainer with custom dark tooltip, gradient area fill, custom legend.

lgpd_anonymization.modal_style: Red warning stroke, clear explanation of anonymization actions (masking CPF, phone, email), requiring confirmation code input.

iconography.usage_rules: Use precise 18px-20px icons with strokeWidth 1.75. Never use emoji characters as UI icons.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: ALL interactive buttons, form inputs, table rows, tab triggers, modal toggles, drag cards, and metrics must have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='kanban-card-lead-123', data-testid='convert-lead-button', data-testid='emit-nfe-button').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text over dark surfaces must maintain at least 4.5:1 ratio. Interactive elements must highlight text on hover (e.g. hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is sleek with deep slate backgrounds (#090D16) and subtle neon/emerald accents.
Implement full Portuguese language text suited for Brazilian PMEs (Faturamento, Nota Fiscal, NFe, Tributos, CRM WhatsApp, Vendedor vs Admin).
Kanban board MUST have smooth drag-and-drop or column movement buttons with full column state persistence.
WhatsApp drawer MUST display real-time/simulated chat flow with incoming webhook simulation button for instant testing.
Fiscal NFe tab MUST feature tax decomposition (ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IPI) both in order detail and dedicated invoice breakdown.
Add complete data-testid attributes to all key controls for reliable test execution.
Ensure RBAC switcher or active role badge (Admin / Vendedor) is accessible in topbar to test access restrictions smoothly.
